name: Estonia: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: the Estonia package as a whole (plan-level checklist step)

items.check: K1 recruitment and informed-consent procedure present, on the EC template v2.0, with the Estonian Member State fields and a section for every population pathway in the plan.
K2 recruitment material present for every advertisement, letter, poster or digital item used in Estonia, in every language used.
One L1 information and consent set per population in population_sets whose trigger is true; every enrolled age group and decision-maker has a document pathway.
Estonian patient-facing materials placed in Part II section R (R2) for a multinational trial, or on the EU Q&A route for a mononational trial.
For every Estonian site: M1 English CV, M2 declaration of interests and N1 site suitability form.
O1 insurance certificate present.
P1 compensation form and P2 budget information with the Health Insurance Fund statement present.
Fee and invoice information provided (invoice recipient and decision recipient).
GDPR statement completed in the CTIS Form section.
S1 biological-samples form present.
The document inventory is reconciled with the Estonia Part II document checklist.
Every participant- or representative-facing document is in Estonian and complete.
Every other participant language intended for use has a complete, matching version with the same version and date.
M1 in English; other administrative documents in the language chosen under DECISIONS.md D1.
Blank consent forms and recruitment materials contain no participant signatures.
M1 dated and signed by the Principal Investigator and no more than six months old; N1 signed by a person legally authorised by the study centre (PDF uploaded, .asice original retained where used).
Each Estonian site appears in CTIS, its M1/M2 and its N1 under the same legal name.
Protocol number, EU CT number, sponsor and document versions are consistent across all documents.
Reimbursement and compensation identical in P1 and the participant documents; none in recruitment material.
Insurance wording in the participant documents matches O1.
Data flows, recipients, transfers and retention identical in the GDPR statement, participant documents and protocol.
Sample types, coding, transport, storage, retention in years and destruction identical in S1, the protocol and the participant documents; optional use separated from main-trial consent.
Consent pathways in K1 match the L1 sets in the package.
Documents adapted from the reference package contain the Estonian national additions and no leftovers from the reference country.
items.applies_when: Estonia is not the reference package

items.check: Correct B–S section prefix and CTIS placeholder for each document; GDPR statement in the Form section; Estonian patient-facing materials per the Ravimiamet placement rule.
Unique, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>.
Participant-document names carry a clear population and language label so assessors can match language versions.
Version and date entered in CTIS metadata, not in the title.
Personal names only where disclosure permits (Principal Investigator in M1/M2).
Clean, tracked-change, redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished.
Uploaded filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ] (the period before the extension is fine).
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: Estonia receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: For each document, publication status checked against the current Annex I publication tables (revised CTIS transparency rules applicable from 18 June 2024).
Publishable documents: personal data and CCI identified separately; public version redacts only qualifying material.
Public and assessment versions differ only by the intended redactions; each in the correct CTIS slot.
No personal data or CCI in public structured fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md).
No tracked changes or drafting comments in the clean submission versions; every final PDF opened and checked.
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
